jobs.title: Graduate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Annual salary: Competitive Salary

An opportunity has arisen within the Manufacturing department for a Manufacturing Automation Engineer
, based primarily at our Barnsley
site. As the business continues to invest in capital equipment and technology, this role will play a key part in modernising production through robotics, automation and process optimisation within a complex manufacturing environment. You will join us on a full-time, permanent basis
, and in return, you will receive a competitive salary
.

This role would suit an Automation Engineer with a degree in Robotics and Automation or similar who is focused on delivering practical improvements on the shop floor. The successful candidate will be confident introducing new technology, leading automation projects, and working across teams to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation in key manufacturing processes.

As one of the UK’s leading manufacturers of Kitchen, Bedroom and Bathroom fitted furniture, Symphony has had unsuppressed growth, with over 50 years’ experience. Our emphasis is on providing a high standard for all our products and the services we offer. We are currently seeking the very best people, to further strengthen our position within the industry by appointing dedicated individuals to share in our success.

Key Responsibilities Of Our Graduate Automation Engineer

Identify and deliver automation opportunities across manufacturing operations.
Lead installation, commissioning, and integration of robotic and automated systems.
Develop and optimise robot programs and PLC-controlled processes.
Conduct cost-benefit analysis and support capital investment decisions.
Drive continuous improvement using data analysis and Lean methodologies.

Qualifications

A strong understanding of APQP, PFMEA, Six Sigma and Statistical Process Control methodologies.
Knowledge of manufacturing process design, cell layout and material flow principles.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing techniques and continuous improvement methodologies.
Project management experience with multiple engineering projects.
Knowledge of CAD software, ideally AutoCAD.
A degree in Robotics and Automation or a related discipline.

Additional Requirements

Excellent analytical, fault finding and problem-solving ability.
Strong project management and organisational skills.
Effective communication and stakeholder management.
Ability to influence and work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business improvements.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies and manufacturing processes.
A full UK driving licence as there will be some travel to other manufacturing sites.

This position will be rewarded with a competitive salary. In order for your application to be taken further, please state your required salary.

If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, then please click ‘apply’ today – they’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Work Location:

Belfast, United Kingdom

Hours

35

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Details

We’re committed to providing fair and equitable compensation to all our colleagues. We encourage you to have an open dialogue with a member of our HR Team and ask compensation-related questions, including pay details for this role.

Job Description

TD Securities is offering an opportunity to join our 12-month Technology Graduate Programme in Belfast with a clear focus on engineering, data, and artificial intelligence. TD Securities provides a wide range of capital market products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients.

From your first day on the TDS Technology Graduate Programme, you will contribute to meaningful technical work as part of a global team. The programme combines structured learning with hands-on delivery, giving you experience across engineering, data, and AI while working with colleagues in Belfast and across TD Securities globally.

Application Requirements & Terms of Offer

Position Overview

Contract Type: Full-time, 12-Month Graduate Programme
Dates: July 2027
Location:
Belfast Office: 16-22 Bedford Street

Candidates must have an unrestricted right to work in the UK throughout the entire duration of the program.

All applicants are required to submit their CV and a Cover Letter. Only complete applications will be accepted.

How You Will Contribute

We are looking for technically curious graduates who enjoy solving real problems, learning quickly, and working collaboratively. During the programme, you will complete three rotations, giving you experience across different product and functional technology groups such as Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, Data & AI, and Compliance.

Contribute to targeted team deliverables, developing new functionality and improving the applications, platforms, and data capabilities that support TD Securities businesses globally.
Design, build, test, and improve high-quality software, participating in debugging, peer reviews, and the engineering practices needed to deliver reliable and secure solutions.
Work across the delivery lifecycle, from understanding a problem and shaping a solution through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Who We Are Looking For

Recent graduate (2026) or upcoming 2027 graduate with a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
A strong interest in engineering, data, and AI, with the curiosity to explore emerging technologies and apply them to real problems.
A grounding in programming and software development concepts, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, placements, hackathons, or other practical experience.
A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across disciplines, teams, and regions while taking ownership of your work.
An interest in financial markets and how technology supports a global corporate and investment bank. Prior finance knowledge is not required.
A practical problem-solving mindset, clear communication skills, and a willingness to learn through feedback, review, and iteration.

What you will gain

Hands-on experience delivering technology in a global financial-services environment.
Structured learning, technical coaching, and support from colleagues and peers.
Exposure to software engineering, data and AI challenges with clear business relevance.
Opportunities to build a global network and understand how technology, product, and business teams deliver together.
A foundation for a long-term career in technology and financial markets.

TD Bank Group

Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with more than 100,000 employees in offices around the world, The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group (TD). TD offers a full range of financial products and services through three key business lines: Canadian Retail, U.S. Retail, and Wholesale Banking including TD Securities.

TD Securities is a leading global corporate and investment bank, delivering capital markets products, advisory services, trading expertise, and market insights to corporate, government, and institutional clients worldwide. Operating in 30 cities across the globe, we combine deep industry knowledge, innovation, and global connectivity to help clients achieve their ambitions.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investment we make in our colleagues to help them, and their families achieve their well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, including medical coverage, paid time off, career development, and reward and recognition programs.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Description

Clean Water Network Analyst
Veriflo ltd

Make a Real Difference Every Day

Every day, millions of people rely on safe, clean drinking water. This apprenticeship offers the opportunity to start or develop a practical career in the water industry while gaining valuable experience and an industry-recognised qualification.

As a Network Analyst at Veriflo, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of client projects. Drawing on your experience in project support or a similar role, you will be responsible for preparing job packs, coordinating and scheduling activities, and working closely with field-based, operational and technical teams to ensure work is delivered efficiently and effectively.

You will regularly engage with colleagues, clients and key stakeholders, developing a strong understanding of clean water networks. Using GIS mapping tools, you will compile accurate asset investigation packs to support operational activities and project delivery.

Part of the Celnor Group

Celnor Group is a UK-based environmental services group operating across the Testing, Inspection, Certification and Compliance (TICC) landscape. With a growing portfolio of specialist businesses, Celnor provides essential services that protect people, property and the environment.

What you will do
You will need a strong understanding of the M25 and surrounding areas, you will use GIS mapping, network schematics and Street View to prepare accurate and detailed work packs for field investigations.
Act as the main point of contact for Field Teams, responding to queries and working closely with technical and operational leads to prioritise workloads and ensure smooth project delivery
Prepare and raise Stage 1 and Stage 2 permits to work, with guidance from Network Engineers and Project Managers.
Coordinate site access and traffic management arrangements, liaising with internal teams, local authorities, clients and external stakeholders.
Plan and schedule field activities, ensuring resources are allocated effectively based on technician locations, availability and project requirements.
Monitor project progress, maintaining accurate documentation, audits, shut packs and operational records.
Identify and resolve survey-related issues, ensuring company systems and project trackers are kept accurate and up to date.

Who you are
A minimum of 2 years’ experience in a project support, coordination or similar role, with an understanding of the full project lifecycle.
Confident using Microsoft Office 365, including Word, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams, as well as virtual meeting platforms such as Zoom.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and effectively with colleagues, clients and stakeholders.
Strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to prepare, coordinate and communicate clear, detailed work plans, with a good understanding of project logistics and operational requirements.
Comfortable managing multiple projects, balancing competing priorities and working effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Veriflo?

Our people’s experience has earned Veriflo Great Place To Work® Certification and recognition on the 2026 UK’s Best Workplaces for Development™ list, celebrating organisations that create outstanding opportunities for employees to learn, grow and thrive.

If you are ready to learn, gain hands-on experience and build a long-term career in the water industry, we would love to hear from you. Every apprentice is expected to work towards and successfully achieve the Level 3 Apprenticeship in Water Distribution, and this is your opportunity to develop alongside a supportive team.

Benefits
Health & Lifestyle Rewards Scheme with Benenden Health, including 24/7 GP access, private healthcare options, and discounts at over 3,500 retailers.
Enhanced annual leave, with an additional day awarded for each year of service after five consecutive years, capped at 30 days (excluding bank holidays).
Employer pension contribution set at 1% above the national minimum under auto-enrolment.
Flexible hybrid working model (3:2 office/site to home) following successful completion of probation.
Support and funding for relevant professional qualifications and memberships, in line with company training and professional development policies.
Two companywide events each year, including a summer team-building event and a Christmas party.
Annual appraisal process with a companywide salary review.
Competitive refer-a-friend reward scheme.

.

Important information

Celnor Group and its businesses manage recruitment directly. We do not require agency support for this role and will only engage with recruitment partners from our preferred supplier list where necessary.

We may use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support parts of the recruitment process. AI is not used for candidate screening, scoring or hiring decisions. All hiring decisions are made by people, for people. Our recruitment systems are ISO 42001 accredited, reflecting our commitment to ethical, transparent and responsible use of technology.

jobs.description:
Programme start date: September 2027

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application.

Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.

As a graduate, you will join the FTSE Russell Division. The division is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where instant reaction and long-term vision are equally important.

Our FTSE Russell division helps investors make better-informed decisions for indices and benchmarking solutions. FTSE Russell provides category-defining indices across asset classes and investment objectives to create new possibilities for the global investment community.

To be eligible, you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027.

Highlights of the Graduate Programme

Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success
Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets, and the business during your global induction
Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions
Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
Access opportunities to earn industry-recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during the programme
Connect with the global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to FTSE Russell, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

This is a great opportunity for students studying a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics subject
or Finance, Economics with a strong inclination towards FinTech/Technology to apply their skills to a Business-related role. During the recruitment process, we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business to place you in your first rotation.

What We Are Looking For

We are passionate about recruiting people who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.
You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
Individuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.
The environment we work in is fast-paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.
Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the UK without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.

Application close: 28 November.
We consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend you apply early.

Recruitment Process

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.
The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.
The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style.
The final stage is a half-day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make
one application. If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

jobs.title: Privacy Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

About The Role

We're looking for a hands-on, technically driven Privacy Systems Analyst to own Rover's privacy technology platform stack. You'll be the technical operator behind our privacy compliance program: configuring, integrating, troubleshooting, and maintaining our privacy management platform and the systems connected to it.

You'll partner closely with the GRC team, who own the program-level requirements, and make sure what compliance defines, the platform reliably delivers. We're especially looking for someone with a strong instinct for automating manual work, including with AI tooling, and the technical depth to keep the privacy stack performing at scale.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

What You'll Do:

Own the privacy platform: configure and maintain workflows, assessments, consent management, DSAR automation, and reporting. Be the go-to person when something isn't working
Coordinate consent and marketing preferences: support opt-in/opt-out workflows with Marketing, Legal, and Engineering; ensure preference signals are captured, synced, and enforced correctly downstream; troubleshoot gaps between what's configured and what's actually enforced
Manage integrations and APIs: own the API surface connecting the privacy platform to other Rover systems, including authentication, error handling, and monitoring
Handle DSARs end to end: ensure connectors fire correctly, monitor success rates, and resolve errors that block fulfillment
Keep RoPA and Data Map accurate: maintain connectors, validate data inventory, and onboard new sources
Lead new integrations: act as technical lead on integration projects, from design through go-live
Support incident response: partner with Cybersecurity on privacy/security incidents, owning platform-level triage and technical evidence collection
Build AI-driven automation: identify manual, repetitive work (DSAR intake, RoPA upkeep, documentation, vendor tickets) and build AI-assisted workflows to reduce it, always with human review for compliance-sensitive output
Document and mentor: keep configurations, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides current; support more junior team members
Own the vendor relationship: raise and manage technical escalations with evidence, and engage vendor professional services only when the work genuinely exceeds in-house capability

What You'll Need:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2-5 years administering SaaS platforms, with experience leading moderately complex projects
Hands-on experience with an enterprise privacy management platform (consent management, DSAR automation, data discovery)
Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth/API keys, webhooks, and integration troubleshooting
Understanding of SaaS architecture: environments, sandbox-to-production, change management
Strong independent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
Clear communication, especially with non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable working autonomously and knowing when to escalate
Practical, hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to automate workflows, draft documentation, or accelerate troubleshooting

Nice to Have:

Vendor certifications (OneTrust, Ketch, DataGrail, TrustArc, or similar)
Cloud fundamentals certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
GDPR/CCPA or global privacy regulation awareness
Scripting experience (Python, JavaScript)
IAM/SSO knowledge
Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) or calling LLM APIs directly
Awareness of AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001)

Benefits of Working at Rover.com:

Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office

Compensation:
